productName: ChoiceGuard — Dynamic Google Forms Choice Eliminator & Capacity Limiter

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of limiting sign-up slots and workshop capacity in Google Forms getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With ChoiceGuard, Zero Double-Booking Concurrency Protection runs right where you already work. Per-Option Seat Caps & Automatic Form Closing and One-Click Original Choice Restoration—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle limiting sign-up slots and workshop capacity in Google Forms, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch ChoiceGuard in action: Queues simultaneous form submissions in strict order so the final seat in a popular time slot is removed before the next respondent is confirmed. Set individual seat limits for every multiple-choice, checkbox, or dropdown option—and automatically close the form when all sessions are full. Plus, re-running a recurring weekly sign-up or parent-teacher conference? Restore all eliminated options back to your form in a single click. Student, parent, and attendee responses never leave your Google Form. Zero external cloud servers, zero response-count cutoffs, and zero monthly rent. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
